save_compatibility: Published predecessor store reopens with exact stats, both three-stop trains, all 512 resident records, individual wallets and rail journey plans.
Reviewed reset and one-use restore preserve exact stats, trains and six sampled complete resident/wallet/rail-plan records.
The restored residents continue travelling, checkpoint and survive a second native process restart without reset.

limitations: Shared host, not an isolated hardware benchmark.
Native invocation measurements exclude session saving, transport and timers.
Live timing is delivered simulation cycles, not rendering FPS.
Scaling uses synthetic 8/32/128/256-resident road lattices, not mature 2048-resident cities.
Physical mobile devices and four simultaneous heavy cities are not certified.
